# swarm-dev

> A Claude Code plugin that turns an agreed epic into merged PRs: agents split it into one-PR stories, then build them in parallel, each in its own visible herdr pane. The user approves each plan and, with `merge = human`, each merge, except a PR whose agreed HLD grants `merge`, which the lead merges (never a `costs: money` one).

First steps: install the plugin (`claude plugin marketplace add redscaresu/swarm-dev`, `claude plugin install swarm-dev@swarm-dev`, then restart Claude Code); run `claude` once in the project folder and have the user accept the trust prompt; run `swarm.sh init` from the git repo's root to create the board; then run `/swarm-dev:swarm` to drive the chain.

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): how an agent uses swarm-dev in a project and works on this repo

- [docs/reference-planning.md](docs/reference-planning.md): writing an HLD or an epic, and planning either

- [rules.md](rules.md): swarm-dev's rules, which every builder follows and every reviewer holds a PR to
- [docs/dash.md](docs/dash.md): the read-only dashboard
- [commands/](commands/): the slash commands the plugin loads (`/swarm-dev:epic`, `/swarm-dev:plan-epic`, `/swarm-dev:swarm`)
